places-segment-el-tambo-honorato-vasquez.story: From Cañar it runs 262 km to Cañar; allow about 4 h 31 of riding. The stops in between: Subsection Achupallas - Ingapirca, Segment Cerro de Cojitambo, Historic Centre of Santa Ana de los Ríos d and back through Segment Cerro de Cojitambo. The highest point is about 3,750 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

places-abric-de-la-mostela-penon-de-sant.title: Abric de la mostela and Peñón de Santo Espíritu

waypoints.name: Abric de la mostela
waypoints.advice: Abric de la mostela is where the day begins. Next is La Joquera.

waypoints.name: La Joquera
waypoints.advice: La Joquera comes up 63 km in. Next is Peñón de Santo Espíritu.

waypoints.name: Peñón de Santo Espíritu
waypoints.advice: 125 km in you reach Peñón de Santo Espíritu. Next is back through La Joquera.

waypoints.name: back through La Joquera
waypoints.advice: back through La Joquera, late in the day. Next is Abric de la mostela.

waypoints.name: Abric de la mostela
waypoints.advice: Back at Abric de la mostela. That is the ride.

sections.advice: Abric de la mostela → La Joquera is 57 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
La Joquera → Peñón de Santo Espíritu is 59 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Peñón de Santo Espíritu → back through La Joquera is 59 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
back through La Joquera → Abric de la mostela is 57 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

places-abric-de-la-mostela-penon-de-sant.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-abric-de-la-mostela-penon-de-sant.story: A 250 km round trip from Catí - roughly 4 h 19 in the saddle. On the way it passes La Joquera, Peñón de Santo Espíritu and back through La Joquera. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
